attributes.title: 2027 ACCP Global Conference on Clinical Pharmacy
attributes.series: ACCP Global Conference on Clinical Pharmacy
attributes.summary:
The American College of Clinical Pharmacy lists its 2027 Global Conference on Clinical Pharmacy for Saturday, October 16, to Tuesday, October 19, 2027, in New York City. The official meeting location and hotel is the New York Hilton Midtown.

ACCP's fall meeting usually combines clinical pharmacy education, research presentations and board certification sessions. For 2027 the program, CE hours and registration fees have not been published yet; we will add them when ACCP posts the meeting site.
